title: Inputs
description: Bring tracking, animation, and character data into a node graph. These nodes follow the Inputs frame in the screenshot; Custom Inputs are documented separately.
summary: Receive tracking, sample animation, and read character data.
imageAlt: Yugo nodes arranged in Inputs and Custom Inputs frames in Blender

title: Custom Inputs
description: Provide your own values, Blender references, character maps, and metadata. Use these nodes when a graph needs a specific value or a manually selected source.
summary: Supply values, object references, images, and custom maps.
imageAlt: Yugo Inputs and Custom Inputs frames, with value and mapping nodes on the right

title: Math / Mixer
description: Calculate numeric and vector values, remap ranges, and combine compatible data. Math and Mixer share this page to keep the reference compact.
summary: Calculate, remap, clamp, and combine data.
imageAlt: Yugo Math, Mixer, and FlowControl frames in Blender

title: Flow Control
description: Decide when a graph branch runs, where its update events go, and when it continues. This page follows the FlowControl frame in the screenshot.
summary: Schedule, route, delay, and coordinate update events.
imageAlt: Yugo Math, Mixer, and FlowControl frames, including event routing nodes
note: Update Event sockets carry scheduled events. Trigger sockets such as Condition and Open carry a value used as a condition.

title: Motion Operation
description: Adjust humanoid motion before converting it to transforms for your character. Use masks, weights, smoothing, mirroring, and timing to shape the result.
summary: Shape humanoid motion and convert it to bone transforms.
imageAlt: Yugo Motion Operation and Expression Operation frames in Blender
note: The Mixer in this frame is the same [Mixer](math-mixer.html#mixer) used elsewhere, configured for Humanoid Motion or Bone Transforms.

title: Expression Operation
description: Create and adjust expression channels, then convert them into shape-key values for your character. Channel names and the character expression map connect these operations to the intended facial controls.
summary: Control expression channels and convert them to shape-key values.
imageAlt: Yugo Motion Operation and Expression Operation frames, including facial expression nodes
note: The Mixer in this frame is [Mixer](math-mixer.html#mixer) configured for Expressions. Its Replace, Add, and Maximum modes combine expression streams in different ways.

title: Outputs
description: Apply evaluated data to Blender objects, bones, and shape keys. Each output needs both its data connections and an update event at Enter.
summary: Apply object transforms, bone transforms, and shape-key values.
imageAlt: Yugo Outputs frame with Apply Transform, Bone Transforms to Armature, and ShapeKeysValues to Objects List
note: For a regular update rate, connect [Hz Trigger](flow-control.html#hz-trigger). For simulated transforms, the [YugoPhysics Solver](physics.html#yugophysics-solver) Updated event can drive the output when simulation data advances.

title: Physics
description: Build physics descriptions from VRM springs and rigid objects, then run them through the shared YugoPhysics solver.
summary: Convert spring and rigid-object data into a shared simulation.
imageAlt: Yugo Physics frame with spring conversion, rigid body conversion, and YugoPhysics Solver
